author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The OneXPlayer 3 has some big wins: 8.8" OLED screen, Intel's monster G3 Extreme CPU, detachable controls, and a price that competes with the larger companies. But those advantages are also hindered by some smaller details, so let's put it all together to see if this is the luxury handheld PC for you.

More info: https://www.indiegogo.com/en/projects/one-netbook/onexplayer-3-next-gen-3-in-1-ai-gaming-and-productivity-handheld

OXP3 impressions video: https://youtu.be/Fjv8xPLnWu4
MSI Claw review (for G3E benchmarks): https://youtu.be/JjMEJhofVzU

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
